Hi Samantha — Jordan here (security/sales ops). Looping Marissa for the questionnaire responses and attachments. Below is the current status and what we can provide immediately: 

SOC 2:
- Status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted inference platform in 2026; we maintain an annual Type II report. We can share a redacted SOC 2 report (redacts customer and proprietary details) or a formal SOC 2 summary document.
- Scope: Controls over security, availability, and confidentiality for the hosted API (production control plane + inference runtime).
- Auditor: Kepler & Associates.
- Next audit cycle: report period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 (final report expected Q1 2028).

Incident Response / Breach Notification:
- Detection & containment: Our IR team has an internal SLA to acknowledge incidents within 2 hours of detection and to begin containment activities immediately.
- Customer notification: For confirmed incidents affecting customer data, Redwood commits to notifying customers within 72 hours of confirmation (or sooner where legally required). Notifications include summary, scope of impact, containment steps, and remediation plan. Root-cause and forensic reports follow as they are available.
- Escalation: We provide a single point-of-contact during incidents and can enable bridge calls for impacted customers.

BCP/DR Evidence:
- RTO/RPO: For Redwood-managed hosted endpoints, typical RTO is 4 hours for critical control-plane operations and RPO < 1 hour for KV-cached states; batch/throughput degradation scenarios vary by model and region.
- Tests: Quarterly DR tabletop exercises and semi-annual full failover tests for control plane. We can share recent test summaries.

Attachments (shared): SOC2_summary.pdf (summary + auditor), Redwood_IR_Playbook.pdf (redacted IR playbook), BCP_DR_Evidence.zip (test summaries & DR checklists). We will upload to a secured Drive folder and share a link — please confirm preferred transfer method (secure Drive link or SFTP). 

Questionnaire ownership: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) will be primary; she’ll start filling the XLSX and flag anything that needs legal review.

Next steps we’ll take today:
- Upload docs to secure Drive and share link with FinTechCorp.
- Marissa will start the questionnaire and aim to return a draft by EOD Tue (4/6).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOC2_summary.pdf, Redwood_IR_Playbook.pdf, BCP_DR_Evidence.zip
